jobs.description:
North Richland Hills Role Highlights

Role Essentials

  • Project-based work with clear objectives.
  • Benefits: This role offers competitive pay.
  • Based in: North Richland Hills, TX (our growing North Richland Hills office)
  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Security And Financial Logistics space in North Richland Hills.
  • Flexible Role in North Richland Hills: Armored Truck Driver And Messenger
  • Pay: $22-$27/Hour (approx. $51k/Year)
  • Employer: GardaWorld (Hiring in North Richland Hills)
  • This North Richland Hills-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our GardaWorld team in North Richland Hills, TX is growing.
  • Benefit from working in North Richland Hills, a key hub for the Security And Financial Logistics industry.

About GardaWorld

GardaWorld is a global champion in security services, integrated risk management, and cash solutions. We protect the high-value assets of financial institutions, major retailers, and government agencies worldwide. We offer our employees a robust, highly secure working environment where discipline, integrity, and safety are the highest operational priorities. We pride ourselves on hiring professionals who thrive in high-stakes environments.

A Timeline of Your Daily Operations

  • 6:00 AM - Secure Dispatch: Arrive at the heavily fortified GardaWorld vault facility. You will arm yourself, review the daily manifest with your partner, and conduct a rigorous mechanical and security inspection of the armored commercial vehicle.
  • 7:30 AM - Tactical Routing: Navigate the armored vehicle safely through dense city traffic or suburban routes. You must maintain absolute situational awareness and utilize defensive driving techniques to prevent accidents and mitigate security risks.
  • 10:00 AM - Asset Transfer: Act as the armed messenger. You will exit the vehicle to securely deliver and pick up cash deposits, coins, and valuable assets from retail clients and ATMs, operating with hyper-vigilance while your partner secures the perimeter.
  • 3:00 PM - Vault Reconciliation: Return safely to the branch facility. You will follow strict, heavily audited procedures to transfer the collected assets back into the vault and complete all digital and physical chain-of-custody paperwork.

The Security Advantage

This is a highly structured, rewarding role that combines commercial driving with elite physical security. You will enjoy a predictable daytime schedule. GardaWorld provides a highly competitive hourly wage, comprehensive medical and dental insurance, robust 401(k) options, and all necessary tactical and firearms training.

Qualifications

Must be at least 21 years of age. A valid driver's license with a pristine driving record is required (commercial license preferred but not always mandatory). You must possess or be willing and able to obtain a state-issued armed security guard license and a permit to carry a firearm. A flawless criminal background, exceptional ethical integrity, and the physical ability to lift heavy coin bags (up to 50 lbs) are mandatory.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Every Tarian Teammate contributes significantly to our mission. Whether you are a frontline employee or work behind the scenes, you are the reason why Tarian is TRUSTED TO PROTECT. You are a member of a diverse team working in an inclusive and dynamic environment. You will provide direct security and related public services.

Compensation: $17.75/Per Hour. Part-Time

Benefits:

Our full-time positions offer role specific on-the-job training, career paths, and a full range of benefits.

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Supplemental Medical Reimbursement Plans
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays*
  • 401k Plan & Free Retirement Planning Consulting
  • Short-term & Long-term Disability Income Protection Benefits
  • Life Insurance for Teammate and Family
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Recognition & Reward Program
  • Perks Discount Programs with 3,000 free classes from yoga to financial wellness.
  • Wellness Program
  • Pet Insurance

POSITION SUMMARY:

Provides direct security and related public services.

Responsibilities:

You will conduct the following responsibilities, upholding Tarian's commitment to safety and security while supporting the values and culture of the client and community.

  • Our Healthcare Security Officers are responsible for maintaining the security and safety of the hospital, its staff, and its patients and visitors -- and serve as a visible deterrent to illegal activities on hospital property. Our Security Officers also provide supervision for at-risk patients in the hospital environment.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.
Qualifications:

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Completed High School Diploma or GED
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain any applicable licenses or certifications
  • Strong vision abilities including color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Must be able to stand and/or walk for an entire work shift, move or lift objects up to 80 lbs., help restrain or lift a person
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet Tarian company driving guidelines if applicable (for Driving Roles).

Employment Verification
For applicable roles, previous employment must be verified through our background vendor. If any employment cannot be confirmed, candidates may be required to provide proof of employment (such as a pay stubs or W-2s)

Desired Qualification of the Security Officer:

  • Previous work experience with the public in a service setting

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT
Work hours will vary depending on assignments, client schedules, project deadlines, and the needs of the company. Workweeks may exceed 40 hours and may involve any of the 7 days of the week, depending on the needs of the business. The work environment may be fast-paced and stressful or may also be quiet and slow-paced. All environments and pace of work will require alertness and ability to perform under pressure.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee must be able to sit, stand, and walk for variable amounts of time throughout an assigned shift; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; occasionally stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move objects 25 pounds or more. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Frequently engages in mental concentration, analysis, and formulation.

About Tarian
Tarian stands out as North America’s foremost expert and trusted security partner, a distinction attributed not only to the solutions and services we provide but also as a testament to the incredible individuals on our team. Their diverse backgrounds and experiences continuously drive innovation and excellence across our company, enabling our growth and success.

At Tarian, we believe in the extraordinary power of people to enact positive change. Our visionis to shape a future where safety and security are not only foundations for enduring success but also powerful catalysts for positive change. We offer more than employment; we provide a career path rich in purpose and fulfillment. By joining Tarian, you become part of a greater mission. Through the creation of safe environments, you empower people, communities, and organizations to thrive and achieve their full potential, as well as your own.

Be Extraordinary. Always. Join Tarian in safeguarding what matters most.

Tarian is an equal opportunity employer.
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

Job Description

Position Purpose:

The Asset Protection Specialist is primarily responsible for preventing financial loss caused by theft and fraud and supporting safety and environmental program compliance in their assigned store/multiple stores. They utilize tools to minimize loss to the Company, including but not limited to identifying incidents of theft and fraud, reviewing CCTV and exception reports, monitoring the store's physical security, auditing the Electronic Article Surveillance and driving a shrink elimination culture in the store. Other responsibilities include: preparing accurate and detailed case reports documenting your apprehensions and recoveries, preserving evidence, interacting with law enforcement and testifying in criminal and civil court actions. The Asset Protection Specialist must report any hazardous or unsafe condition to the Manager on Duty and carry out job responsibilities in a manner that minimizes the risk of injury to themselves, other associates, vendors, customers, and the Company. They must demonstrate integrity at all times, respond to asset protection and operational concerns of all associates and remain focused on store specific business objectives while supporting key asset protection and operational responsibilities.

jobs.title: Security Patrol Officer - Variable Schedule
jobs.company: Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County
jobs.description:
More than a career...it's a calling!


Founded in 1888, Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a united Christian organization and ministry dedicated to providing love, hope, respect, and a new beginning for homeless women, men, and families. UGM-TC is funded entirely by the generosity of the community and offers a residency program for individuals looking to maximize their potential and transition out of homelessness. Through the programs and services provided, individuals develop essential life skills to become independent, productive members of our community. UGM-TC is God’s healthy place to end homelessness one person at a time. Come serve with us!  




UGM is seeking a flexible Security Patrol Officer able to work a variable schedule regarding hours and days worked based on the organization's changing needs.






Position Summary:


The selected individual will patrol and secure assigned premises as well as identify and mitigate risks to staff and patrons. We are looking for active, dependable individuals that are highly motivated. Former military or law enforcement experience preferred! This position requires individuals to stand/walk for extended periods of time. There will be routine checks and code compliance requirements for the 10-acre campus of Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County.  We also service The Vineyards of Lancaster, registering visitors, taking calls, and ensuring visitors have registered vehicles while conducting routine patrols. 


What You Do: 



  • Patrol buildings and grounds. 

  • Maintain campus security and follow lock protocols. 

  • Provides individual and group escorts to and from parking areas. 

  • Identifies and removes unauthorized individuals from property. 

  • Enforces campus parking policies/cites violations. 

  • Executes Courtesy Patrol policies, procedures, and standards with excellence. 

  • Provides campus directions to facility visitors. 

  • Interacts with police, fire personnel, EMS, patients, visitors, and staff. 

  • Completes incident / offense reports and composes narratives by performing investigations, recording observations, taking statements, gathering information, citing occurrences, and utilizing surveillance activities.  

  • Make eye contact and greet all people with respect. 

  • Responds to calls for service and emergency situations with urgency and professionalism. 

  • Assesses the situation and utilizes appropriate de-escalation measures. 

  • Utilizes critical thinking skills. 

  • Responds to and activates the appropriate emergency response codes.  

  • Supports activities and events by utilizing appropriate crowd control techniques representative of UGM.  

  • Work overnights, weekends, evening hours, and holidays as needed by the organization.  

  • The central job functions of this position are not limited to the duties listed above. 


 


Qualifications / What You Bring:  



  • 3-5 years of security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred. 

  • Familiarity with security equipment.

  • Ability to handle physical workload (walking/standing)

  • Bilingual:  Spanish Speaking a plus

  • Level 2 License preferred

  • Strong attention to detail 

  • An ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds at varying levels of understanding.  

  • Problem Sensitivity — The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem. 

  • Deductive Reasoning — The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense. 

  • Flexibility of Closure — The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material. 

  • Inductive Reasoning — The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events). 

  • A clean driving record.






“As part of the screening process, you may be asked to provide a pastoral reference. Union Gospel Mission of Tarrant County is a Christian organization that seeks to hire people who align with our beliefs in Jesus Christ. We welcome all Christian denominations into the mission.”
